column1: # Session 94 (gpu_sweep.ps1): Intel Gen9 (HD 520 / UHD 620) on the OLD OEM driver era 100.x (Windows). NOT from a real log of ours: values from
# docs\research\gpu_matrix_s93.md section 2.6 (100.x: 128 MiB storage range, no EDS / VIDS / robustness2) and rule table section 3 #8, #17
# (Intel Windows: VIDS off, shaderFloat16 off). Driver "100.7212" = the 2-part Intel Windows number (31.0.100.7212). Intel keeps BCn and D24S8,
# so no format gaps are emulated. The tier ("igpu") and the quirks table for INTEL_PROPRIETARY_WINDOWS fire from vendor 8086.
# Storage alignment 16 cannot be emulated beyond the PC's own (min limits only go up).
